- Key stakeholders: Engineering lead (Priya), Platform/FinOps (Alex), and internal security reviewer as needed.

To move forward: please pick one of the 30-min windows below for a quick product intro + Q&A. We’ll cover a short walkthrough of the runtime, routing/fallback, and an initial cost/latency profile based on your inputs.

Proposed 30-min windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue, May 19 — 9:30–10:00 AM PST
- Option B: Tue, May 19 — 1:00–1:30 PM PST
- Option C: Wed, May 20 — 11:00–11:30 AM PST

If none of these work, tell me a couple of preferred slots and I’ll adapt. Also confirm who from your side will attend (we can tailor the demo to the selected attendees).

Attached: high-level pricing snapshot and a draft mutual action plan that outlines typical procurement and security checkpoints.

Thanks — Jordan
